DECLARED_CHOICES.focal_window: 3-year trailing (y-2..y) for focal attachment, matching the background window
DECLARED_CHOICES.pattern_percentile_reference: all MeSH focal concept-years (not bg nodes)
DECLARED_CHOICES.units_of_weights: background W_i/W_ij are post-stratified population-count estimates (w_year = n_frame/n_sampled); focal W_c/W_cj are census counts of verified works (weight 1); both are counts of population works, so strengths are on one scale
DECLARED_CHOICES.focal_tags_not_in_bg: focal co-tags absent from the window's background vocabulary have no W_j and are dropped (share logged)
DECLARED_CHOICES.volres_fit_set: volume residualisation of intensive indicators is fitted on ALL focal concept-years (outcome-blind, so it can be frozen before labels) instead of 'never-emerging' concept-years
DECLARED_CHOICES.E_labels_outside_age_range: E(c,t) is computable for any t <= 2019; onsets are searched only in t in [F+3, F+8]; a control needs E(c',t*)=0 and no onset <= t*
DECLARED_CHOICES.incubation_rule: a run of >= 2 consecutive network years with beta_sim AND dk below the population median, immediately followed by a year with strength growth above the 90th percentile
DECLARED_CHOICES.centralisation_rule: any run of >= 3 consecutive network years with P < 0.3 on every year and Kendall tau(year, within-module z) > 0.5
DECLARED_CHOICES.bridging_rule: P > 0.6 or betweenness in the top decile of that snapshot's nodes in either of the first 2 network years
DECLARED_CHOICES.kleinberg: batched 2-state, s=2, gamma=1, r_t = concept volume, d_t = OpenAlex all_types total for year t (dataset_1 context/subfield_year_totals.json); Viterbi recomputed on years <= t for each t
DECLARED_CHOICES.leiden_iterations: leidenalg n_iterations=2 (package default) instead of -1: -1 took 95 s per seed per snapshot; on 2014 the n_iterations=2 partition had quality 896,789 vs 899,619 (-0.3%) and seed-to-seed NMI was <0.8 in both settings, so F2 applies: P and z are reported with their spread over the 5 seeds
DECLARED_CHOICES.E_cent_reference: PRIMARY E_cent uses the percentile of weighted degree among MeSH focal nodes of the same snapshot (wdeg_pctl_focal); the plan-literal all-node percentile label is reported as E_cent_allnodes. The A2 baseline's dpctl uses the same focal reference so the baseline sees the outcome-relevant centrality.
DECLARED_CHOICES.precursor_versions: accretion_share, closure_lr, dP are intensive: the 'raw' version is the primary test; the '_volres' version is secondary

labels.E: uptake AND all-node percentile gain >= 20 (main-pool primary)
labels.E_alt: uptake AND focal-population percentile gain >= 20 (main-pool E_alt)
labels.E_up: uptake only (mean >= 20 over t+1..t+5, no fall > 30%)

MAINPOOL.controls: never-emerging concepts (no onset in the eligible window), same F-band and origin group, nearest on log vol3 within +-20% (else +-30%), 1:3 with replacement
MAINPOOL.origin_group: OpenAlex origin field (the main pool's origin group is its stratum prefix, an OpenAlex field or domain id such as F31 / D3)

main_pool_alignment.note: The main-pool RQ1 run (not a rq1_spec.py module, but spec.json + config.py) was found during the run, after this artifact's snapshots were built with the plan's spec. Its constants agree with the plan on window, tag filter, Leiden, top-20 closure, rewiring reps, betweenness pivots, E thresholds, ages, t_max, matching calipers and Kleinberg; its precursor operationalisations (rarefied 3-year-slope accretion shift, weighted Chung-Lu closure, rarefied P), label variants (E, E_alt, E_up) and event-study convention (rel -5..0, summary -3..0, never-emerging controls, vol3 caliper) were added as a SECOND, aligned block (rq1_spec.MAINPOOL) before any outcome of this population was computed. The plan-native block is reported unchanged.

differences.leiden_n_iterations: main pool: leidenalg default (n_iterations not set = 2); here 2 (declared)
differences.kept_edges: main pool: >= 2 RAW sample co-occurrences; here weighted W_ij >= 2 (plan text)
differences.closure_neighbours: main pool: all frame-type co-tags; aligned block uses the same
differences.percentile_strength: main pool: all frame tags; plan block: co-tags with W_cj >= 2
differences.rewire_snapshots: main pool: 2008/2013/2018 only; here 10% of all concept-years
differences.onset_window: main pool: 2008-2015 (sealed 2016-18); here age 3..8 and t <= 2019 (no sealing)
